title: Registered Nurse - Medical / Surgical
summary: We are seeking a compassionate and dedicated Registered Nurse (RN) for our Medical/Surgical unit. The ideal candidate provides high-quality bedside patient care, administers medications, monitors vitals, and collaborates with multidisciplinary healthcare teams.
responsibilities: Assess, plan, implement, and evaluate patient care plans in accordance with hospital standards.
Administer IV therapies, medications, and treatments accurately while observing patient responses.
Collaborate closely with physicians, nurse specialists, and therapists to coordinate discharge planning.
Maintain rigorous patient charting, infection control, and sterile procedures.
Educate patients and their family members regarding treatment plans and post-discharge recovery.
qualifications: Active and unrestricted RN license in New York State.
Minimum of 1-2 years acute care or Med/Surg hospital experience.
Current BLS (Basic Life Support) and ACLS certifications from AHA.
Strong clinical communication, critical thinking, and patient advocacy skills.

title: LPN 1 - Urology Clinic
summary: Exciting outpatient opportunity for a Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) to support daily clinical operations, patient intake, procedural prep, and follow-up care in a thriving urology clinic.
responsibilities: Perform initial patient triage, capture vitals, and document patient medical histories.
Assist attending urologists with in-office minor surgical procedures and cystoscopies.
Handle catheterizations, bladder scans, and specimen collections with strict sterile technique.
Coordinate prescription prior authorizations and phone triage for patient inquiries.
qualifications: Active Delaware or Multi-State Compact LPN License.
BLS certification required.
1+ year clinical outpatient experience preferred.

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (React / Node.js)
summary: Lead the architecture and delivery of modern web applications, scalable REST/GraphQL APIs, and cloud services for high-velocity enterprise talent and staffing systems.
responsibilities: Design, build, and maintain high-performance frontend interfaces with React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
Develop secure microservices with Node.js, Express/NestJS, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
Automate CI/CD pipelines, containerized deployments on AWS/Azure, and infrastructure as code.
Mentor mid-level engineers, drive code review standards, and optimize app performance.
qualifications: 5+ years of software engineering experience in modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems.
Deep knowledge of React state management, hooks, and responsive UX design systems.
Proficiency in REST/GraphQL API design, SQL database modeling, and caching architectures.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience.

title: Financial Analyst - Risk & Compliance
summary: Support quantitative risk evaluation, portfolio stress testing, regulatory audits, and financial forecasting for tier-one banking institutions.
responsibilities: Build robust financial models to evaluate credit, liquidity, and operational risk metrics.
Prepare quarterly compliance documentation for SEC, FINRA, and Federal Reserve guidelines.
Collaborate with asset management teams to monitor covenant compliance and risk caps.
Automate monthly reconciliation reports using Excel VBA, Python, and SQL.
qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or Quantitative Analytics.
3+ years experience in banking, hedge fund, or institutional financial analysis.
CFA or FRM candidacy strongly preferred.

title: Clinical Research Associate (CRA)
summary: Monitor Phase II and Phase III clinical trial sites to ensure protocol adherence, Good Clinical Practice (GCP) compliance, and accurate electronic data capture.
responsibilities: Conduct site qualification, initiation, routine interim monitoring, and close-out visits.
Verify patient informed consent forms, eligibility verification, and source data verification (SDV).
Track adverse events (AEs) and serious adverse events (SAEs) with prompt institutional reporting.
Liaise between principal investigators, hospital research boards, and sponsor trial directors.
qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Nursing, or related scientific discipline.
2+ years onsite or regional monitoring experience in oncology or infectious diseases.
CCRA or ACRP certification is an advantage.

title: Supply Chain Logistics Coordinator
summary: Oversee inbound and outbound freight scheduling, freight forwarder coordination, inventory tracking, and warehouse operations.
responsibilities: Coordinate multi-modal shipments (air, ocean, drayage, LTL/FTL) across North American hubs.
Audit freight bills, customs clearance documents, and bills of lading for compliance.
Track real-time inventory movements in ERP/WMS systems (SAP, Oracle).
Resolve logistics exceptions and shipping delays proactively with carriers.
qualifications: Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, or Logistics.
2+ years logistics dispatch or freight coordination experience.

title: Store Associate / Inventory Specialist
summary: Provide enthusiastic customer assistance, restock shelves, inspect perishable inventory, and process point-of-sale transactions.
responsibilities: Greet store patrons and guide them to products with polite and attentive service.
Receive freight deliveries, inspect product expiration dates, and arrange display shelves.
Operate digital cash registers and handle credit card/cash transactions accurately.
Maintain store cleanliness, sanitation protocols, and aisle safety.
qualifications: High school diploma or GED equivalent.
Prior retail, grocery, or hospitality customer service experience welcomed.
Ability to lift up to 35 lbs and stay active throughout the shift.

title: Telecom Systems Engineer
summary: Deploy, test, and optimize next-generation optical transmission and 5G cellular base station equipment for telecommunication operators.
responsibilities: Configure DWDM, microwave backhaul, and carrier Ethernet switches.
Execute fiber characterization testing (OTDR, chromatic dispersion, PMD).
Analyze drive test metrics and tune RF handover parameters for high-traffic cell sites.
Prepare network cutover migration plans and coordinate emergency outage recovery.
qualifications: Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, or Computer Networks.
3+ years telecom field or NOC engineering experience.
CCNA/CCNP Service Provider or equivalent OEM certifications preferred.

title: Construction Project Safety Manager
summary: Drive workplace safety leadership across utility-scale energy construction projects, ensuring OSHA compliance and zero-incident site culture.
responsibilities: Conduct daily job hazard assessments, toolbox talks, and site audits across subcontractors.
Enforce OSHA 1926 construction regulations and environmental permit conditions.
Investigate near-misses and incidents to establish root cause and corrective measures.
Manage safety documentation, certifications, and local authority inspections.
qualifications: 5+ years safety leadership in commercial construction or energy utility projects.
OSHA 30 Construction and CSP or CHST certification.
Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus.

title: Automotive Quality Assurance Engineer
summary: Lead PPAP validations, root-cause investigations, and APQP product launch milestones for electric vehicle battery and motor components.
responsibilities: Implement Statistical Process Control (SPC) and Gage R&R studies on manufacturing lines.
Lead 8D corrective actions for supplier defects and assembly discrepancies.
Collaborate with design engineers on GD&T tolerances and DFM recommendations.
qualifications: Bachelor’s in Mechanical, Industrial, or Automotive Engineering.
3+ years automotive Tier-1 or OEM quality engineering experience.
Six Sigma Green Belt or CQE certification preferred.
